evidenceTier: AS_SERVED_COMMITTED_PRE_KICKOFF — forecast numbers are the last board revision committed (git committer time) and generated before each kickoff; a git commit is not Vercel served-revision evidence (forecast-of-record Option B)

asServed: board family state and basis per event
reconstructed: rolling-4 baseline, rolling-4 line proxy and share×volume baseline: props-v1 evaluator walk-forward rule over the committed ESPN corpus 2023–2026, the evaluator's committed fit (volume.pass.a0, league.catchRate, league.ypr)
P(over line) for the calibration bar: interpolated from the five served quantiles (the board never carried one for this family) — see sensitivity
provenance.settlement: props-v1 participation-true contract on the committed ESPN stat sheets + nflverse offensive snap sheets; special-teams-only appearances void (offense-only snap file, declared difference)

shareLevelForward.source: data/internal/research/nfl/reports/player-props-share-level-preregistration.json frozen.bars (forward2026: no era clauses, no bootstrap)

bars.differ: props-v1 scores MAE on the distribution MEAN and ECE over bins holding ≥ eceMinBinN pairs; the share-level forward bars score MAE on the MEDIAN, ECE over every bin, and add a level band. Both are reported; neither is relaxed.

verdictRule: n below minimumN → ACCUMULATING (no verdict); every bar passes → FORWARD_HOLDING; otherwise FORWARD_BREACHED (forward-player-props-share-level.mjs rule)
verdictBasis: props-v1 promotion bars — the bars the board's PUBLISHED basis cites

barProvenance.coverOk: AS_SERVED — served p10/p90 against settled actuals
barProvenance.level: AS_SERVED — served means against settled actuals (share-level bar set only)
barProvenance.beatsRolling: served forecast vs RECONSTRUCTED rolling-4 baseline
barProvenance.beatsShareVol: served forecast vs RECONSTRUCTED share×volume baseline
barProvenance.calOk: RECONSTRUCTED — rolling-4 line proxy and quantile-interpolated P(over); see calibrationSensitivity

calibrationSensitivity.note: ECE recomputed with P(over) at each end of its step bound — not intervals, just how far the interpolation choice can move the calibration number

baselineCoverage.note: a served player with no prior game at his current team in the ESPN corpus gets rolling-4 0 and share 0, as in the evaluator
